description: Use this when someone who owns or works for a small business wants to see what Suara would post for them. Give the business name plus its own website and/or up to 3 photos from the chat (not Instagram or delivery-app pages). Returns 3 designed posts with captions, full size, ready to use, made from the business's own photos and words; about a minute, so if it says they're still being made, call it again with the same business. Nothing is posted anywhere and no account is needed. One sample per person per day. Only for a business the user owns or works for.

language.description: Language for the captions, optional (default: the business's own)

photos.description: Up to 3 photos of the business uploaded in the chat

website.description: The business's own website (https), optional if photos are given

what_to_promote.description: Something to feature in one post, optional (e.g. weekend brunch)

name: make_sample_posts
title: Make 3 sample posts
